citaat: Does your tool enable AI-generated annotations directly on student submissions (inline comments, highlights, or suggested feedback)?
samenvatting: Eerste eis is inline annotatie in het werk zelf, niet los feedbackrapport.

citaat: I can see strong value in areas like iterative feedback, consistency of marking, and the potential for inline AI-supported annotation, all very relevant to current sector challenges.
samenvatting: Zij benoemt iteratieve feedback en consistentie als sectorbrede pijn.

citaat: I'm currently a TeacherMatic affiliate, so I need to stay up to date with emerging tools in this space.
samenvatting: Ze zit al aan TeacherMatic vast, dus geen neutrale adviseur.

citaat: There seems to be genuine interest in exploring how the platform may support reflective practice, learner engagement, evidence capture, and more personalised assessment feedback within apprenticeship delivery.
samenvatting: Haakje bij apprenticeships is reflectie plus bewijslast, niet nakijktijd.

citaat: The pilot aims to capture learning progress and provide rigorous evidence for Ofsted, benefiting both UVAC members and learners.
samenvatting: Ofsted-bewijslast is bij apprenticeships de echte drijfveer.

citaat: reassuring to see that there is already a Jisc pilot agreement and DPA structure in place, as that would certainly help reduce barriers for participating HEIs
samenvatting: Jisc-DPA haalt de compliance-drempel weg bij UK-instellingen.

citaat: The current payment and close-out structure potentially creates some pressure around what constitutes a 'successful' pilot outcome. A pilot should ideally provide institutions with the opportunity to test the platform, reflect on impact, identify limitations, and determine fit within their own context, without feeling commercially committed from the outset.
samenvatting: Onze succesfee maakt de pilot commercieel geladen, dat blokkeert hen.

citaat: Ze vond ook dat wij te commercieel waren en dat dit liever 'collaborative' is bedoelende gratis.
samenvatting: Koepel verwacht gratis samenwerking, geen betaalde pilot.

citaat: on balance, we feel it would be best to pause the conversation for now and revisit it towards the end of the summer. It will also allow UVAC time to review priorities and plans for the new academic year.
samenvatting: Pauze tot na de zomer omdat de jaarprioriteiten nog niet vaststaan.
